text:
Elliot: starting orbiton64k int4v2 onboarding with tile-coalescing enabled. target ctx=65536 prefill ~61k. I see a weird 'phase-smear' where tokens from earlier ~59k span bleed into output but only as partial n-grams. Logs below.
Priya: repro command I used:
```
./onboard_run --model orbiton64k --quant int4v2 --context 65536 --prefill 61000 --tile-coalesce=1 --rope=per-tile
```
Marco: symptom: instead of repeating whole fragments we get interleaved fragments like "alpha beta ... alpha" where "alpha" is 2-3 tokens from ~59k. It's lower amplitude than earlier echoes but corrupts semantics.
Zoe: sanitized log snippet:
```
[loader] prefill=60986
[kv] coalesce_read shard=12 tile=7 idx=18446744073709551609
[rope] applied phase=0.99876 computed_phase=1.00123
[decode] emitted: ... 2119 3120 2119 ...
```
Elliot: note the offset looks like -7 under signed; coalesce path may mask signed checks.
Priya: bisect points to coalesce merge added in v2.2 where we combined small tiles to reduce RPCs. good perf but may introduce index aliasing under eviction races.
Marco: repro rate ~12% with coalesce=1, ~0.4% with coalesce=0. Enabling prefix-snapshots at 8k removes incidents but costs mem.
Zoe: quick mitigation patch: add bound-check when coalescing tiles and ensure tile_idx uses int64 intermediate. Running smoke now.
ci-bot: orbiton-coalesce-smoke (patch/avoid-index-alias)  FAIL  regression=phase-smear(3)
Elliot: failing traces show coalesce_read returned stale KV when atomic eviction raced with the coalesce merge. the stale tile's rotary phase computed for earlier prefix leads to subtle overlap pattern.
Priya: proposed actions:
- Marco: add defensive casting and an assert in coalesce path. instrument a counter for "coalesce-alias".
- Zoe: expand goldset tests with 4 long prompts that previously had subtle smears. add nightly.
- Elliot: run perf microbench with coalesce=0/1 and snapshot=0/8192/16384 to map cost-quality curve.
- Priya: consider a soft-fence on eviction when coalesce_commit in-flight (cheap atomic) instead of full global lock.
Marco: I'll open PR with guard + counter and a small perf harness.
Elliot: thanks. keep updates short here; DM if you need logs. :mag:
